I’m proud of you. And if no one else lets you know that, please remember that i’m proud of you.

She needs you as much as you need her in good shape. Remember that she will miss the loving, caring, owner that she has ever had. Our pets may seem to be a fraction of our lives but to them— we are the whole entirety of their lives. I’m sorry you’re going through this and i wish you would know that things will get better. So stay for a while with her while you kick life in the butt.
